## b1e8f6552b5f

Assigned generator SHA: `dd6e83a8125e0ed57482908f7eccf57a1142fce6dbaa59af99f7588aa3a060fe`; rule hash: `94525d5f470a`. The target source was not edited.

### Reproduced defect: invalid `sample_index` scalars are accepted

The generator accepts `sample_index=True`, `False`, and `-1`; each call returns a grid that its own `self_check` accepts. Exact generated-grid hashes and shapes are in [`checks/audit/b1e8f6552b5f/strict_scalar_reproducer.json`](checks/audit/b1e8f6552b5f/strict_scalar_reproducer.json). The independent defect-lint receipt flags the same three cases in [`checks/audit/b1e8f6552b5f-defect/checks/b1e8f6552b5f_audit_defect_lint.log`](checks/audit/b1e8f6552b5f-defect/checks/b1e8f6552b5f_audit_defect_lint.log).

Expected contract: `sample_index` is a nonnegative literal integer, so booleans must not pass as integers and negative values must fail before `gen_ctx`.

### Other checks

The combined audit executed 9 portable task tests, all passing, and the strict semantic stage passed. The combined preset result is [`checks/audit/b1e8f6552b5f-combined/result.json`](checks/audit/b1e8f6552b5f-combined/result.json). I found no source-bound semantic shortcut strong enough to report after those checks; this is not an approval of the scalar API defect.
